$comment: Uncached seconds per Nx task for the CI test-shard dealer (scripts/src/test-shard-dealer.ts --graph --targets test): each test unit's own `<project>:test` or `<project>:test:shard-<n>` task, and the tasks the `test` tasks depend on. Test units, source: the executed (not cache-replayed) `test` and `test:shard-<n>` tasks in the 759 `Affected (test-<n>)` job logs longer than 4 min of the 173 green merge-group runs of ci.yml created 2026-11-18T06:00Z to 2026-11-21T11:39Z, on hosted ubuntu runners at --parallel=1 (tau-brain research/artifacts/ci-decomposition-blueprint/remeasure-2026-11-23/). A task's seconds are its wall time in the streamed job log, from its `> nx run` line to its last prefixed output line (within 1 s of Vitest's own Duration); each value is the median of the samples since 2026-11-19T05:00Z where a unit has three or more, otherwise of all its samples (replicad went from about 74 s to about 300 s with tau #2611 on 2026-11-19). Units of 45 s or more are listed, plus every unit of the previous snapshot. `ui:test` is the sum of its six shard tasks, for a deal that ever sees `ui` whole. Dependency tasks, source: the 138 successful `Affected (test-<n>)` jobs of the 23 green merge-group runs of ci.yml created 2026-11-23T09:34Z to 2026-11-24T21:56Z; a task's seconds are the gap from its `> nx run` line to the next task's or the run's end, and each value is the median of its executed (not cache-replayed) samples. Every dependency of a `test` task in the workspace graph (`nx run-many -t test --exclude tag:scope:api,tag:ci:nightly-only`) that took half a second or more is listed (CI decomposition global review G5: in queue run 45350462131, test-4 spent 137 s on forty builds for cli:test). A unit's own task not listed weighs defaultSeconds, the median measured unit; a dependency not listed weighs nothing. Refresh when a listed task's median moves by more than a quarter, when a project is split, or when this snapshot is older than 60 days.
